name: Personality Development and Yogasan Training Camp for Schedule Caste
benefit: - **Training:** The selected Scheduled Caste youth will receive 7 days of training focused on personality development and yogasana.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be between the age of 14 to 35 years.
